test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcb249597f540e100c763346b42ce60f374cf5056d77672cd4c496d3d257b381.png] 

Logic followed here is:

The difference between the positional values of consecutive letters in each letter-cluster follows a consistent pattern of -1 and -3, except for the odd one out.

**1) NMJ →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28d8e9e7d529d040d71c13819667526e5a677b85951a95e88cc460f588eec091.png] 

**2) RQN →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e445ed3fd44f0a80f7c35a259626586979e47de71d6eff8cf72d7a42396e96d.png] 

**3) XXT →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9a16856da74dfe5e78970bf994f2036efba84a66077f333fa1efc6f68a0c2a3.png] 

**4) CBY**→

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e7fb4f26fd5c41c66383ca61bc74560baa6465733cffce18f6265c7fb0e63b6.png] 

Therefore, 'XXT' is the odd one out as it does not follow the (-0, -3) pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
